stage_receipts.what_exists: Headless Interchange import of all three meshes with LOD1, sockets, collision, UV channels, lightmap index, Nanite-off, replace-reimport equality, all checks passing; socket-encoding probes.

stage_receipts.result: Three lenses, two skeptics per finding; upheld findings dispositioned in revision v3 (see README 6.2); the mast-proportion finding was refuted because the blockout follows the contract's construction reference; slenderness versus the painted candidate recorded as an owner question.
